title: Alt-Tab not working when SSH session (PuTTYNG) is active
author: opbod
body_snippet:
**What happens** (and what you expected instead): alt-tab behavior not working as expected when an SSH session is opened (PuTTYNG.exe as part of mRemoteNG)). Expectation is that a single alt-tab changes between mRemoteNG and a different app.

**Steps to reproduce:**

1. Open mRemoteNG, open an SSH session
2. Alt-tab between mRemoteNG and another app
3. Observe mRemoteNG keeps on showing and requires at least 2 tabs to change to the other app. Clicking the mRemoteNG button on the taskbar requires...
notes: fix: alt-tab focus bounce with embedded PuTTY; PuttyBase.Focus SetForegroundWindow suspected; Grok+Gemini review in flight
